name: Cho-Z Valkyrie
description: The Turbo layer answers to resonance, not to force. When Valkyrie's blader pushes past his own limit the layer wakes with him, and the wings come off the axis as whips.

special_move.name: Turbo Valkyrie Whip
special_move.description: Valkyrie climbs the wall, drops off the rim and lashes down across the stadium three times on the way through.
flavour_texts: ⚡ **Turbo Valkyrie Whip** — the wings come alive!

abilities.name: Turbo Awakening
abilities.description: Every exchange won wakes the layer further: +9 Attack a stack to 4 stacks, and the gauge fills faster with it.
